transit.detail: Connects Vail to Dotsero with stops in Avon, Edwards, Eagle, the airport and Gypsum

founded.text: First settled in 1882 as a ranching community

timeline.text: Eagle County was formed, with Red Cliff as the first county seat.
After years of changing names, the name Eagle was finally chosen for the town.
The Flight Days celebration dates back to this year.
The Eagle County Fair & Rodeo began.
